=== a declared tool and its capability group ===
$ oh --complete tool we
weather
[exit 0]
$ oh --complete caps rxwngl
rxwngl
rxwngla
[exit 0]

=== built-in tools without a custom declaration ===
$ oh --complete tool re
read
[exit 0]
$ oh --complete tool we
[exit 0]

=== invalid config keeps the built-in tools ===
$ oh --complete tool re
read
[exit 0]
$ oh --complete tool we
[exit 0]
